title: BERGPALM comforter set
description: BERGPALM comforter set, gray/stripe, Twin/Twin X-long BERGPALM comforter set is made from soft 100% cotton and has classic, yarn-dyed stripes. The thicker yarn creates a handcrafted, vintage expression that feels relaxed and invites you to unwind. Easy-care since the comforter can be machine washed.
features: Thread count indicates the number of threads per square inch of fabric. The higher the thread count the more densely woven the fabric.
Filling density is measured in ounces per square yard. The higher the filling density, the fluffier and warmer the comforter.
The roll-packed, compressed comforter regains its original shape and fluffiness after a few days.
Comprises: 1 Twin/Twin XL size comforter 68x92''(173cmx234cm) and 1 Queen size pillow sham 20x30'' (51x72.3").
